art.prompt_style: Graphite pencil sketch illustration with light cross-hatching and soft grey shading, subtle warm beige tint, on a plain pure white background, no paper texture, clean isolated drawings, vintage engineering notebook style.
art.mascot: a small original round-dome robot with one big camera-lens eye, a short antenna, a canvas satchel bag, stubby legs

poses.map: walking while reading a folded paper map
poses.magnifier: leaning forward holding a big magnifying glass
poses.confused: scratching its head, confused, a small question mark above

props.workflow: three blank paper cards pinned on a board, connected left to right by hand-drawn arrows
props.invoices: a tall wobbly stack of blank paper invoices and receipts on a small desk
props.clock: a round wall clock next to an hourglass
props.counter: a small shop counter with an old cash register and a paper bag
props.inbox: an overflowing office letter tray full of blank envelopes
props.phone: a smartphone showing blank chat bubbles on its screen

header.prompt: A single long empty horizontal weathered wooden signboard plank, rough cut ends, a few nails, wood grain, drawn in pencil with light warm wash, centered, wide aspect, completely blank surface.
